description: This file defines a mock class `DispatcherMock` for testing purposes, which implements the `WPEFramework::PluginHost::ILocalDispatcher` interface and uses Google Mock to allow mocking of its methods.

classes.name: DispatcherMock
classes.description: A mock class implementing the ILocalDispatcher interface for use in unit testing, allowing the control and verification of interactions with dispatcher behavior.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the dispatcher mock.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the dispatcher mock.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for a specific interface supported by the dispatcher mock.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the dispatcher with the provided service.

methods.name: Dropped
methods.description: Notifies that a dispatch item was dropped.

methods.name: Invoke (1st overload)
methods.description: Invokes a method on the dispatcher with specific parameters and receives a response.

methods.name: Invoke (2nd overload)
methods.description: Invokes a callback-based method on the dispatcher with specific parameters and receives a response.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a callback from the dispatcher.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token and method with given parameters.
